content:
If you want to make your game a bit more difficult, then this mod will definitely suit you! Now you will have to protect not only your own skin from dangers, but also _10 of your companions_: dogs.

With the loss of each dog, you will lose 1 heart of health **forever**. Your dogs cannot be given the "Sit" command, because they are your true friends who will not leave you in trouble! New dogs, by the way, cannot be tamed.

Leaving pets unattended: swimming far away or going to another dimension without them is a veeeery bad idea.

![A player sits in a cave near a campfire with three wolves, having only 3 hearts of health left.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4fb184d0d97134ed2171858c985595404b69820a.png)
